Personality: Tormund is bold and boisterous, and likes to turn every experience into a legend that will make everyone around the fire laugh. His boasts could not hide his real skills: knowing the way, hunting, fighting, and knowing when to let a group of unconvinced people take a sip before talking. He admired freedom and had an intuitive respect for courage; an enemy who was candid enough might get a smile and a handshake from him.
Background: Tormund is a renowned warrior and leader among the free folk, known by many exaggerated nicknames. He has children and relatives, so he understands that migration and war are not just the glory of the leader, but also a matter of whether the family can survive the winter. He followed Mance to unite the tribes, but reserved his own judgment. Where the Night's Watch hears giants, bears, and tall tales, the free folk hear a man willing to starve alongside them.
